title: BYD Just Overtook Tesla In EV Sales
hook: Tesla just lost its EV crown.
source: Tesla annual deliveries (company reports): 2019 0.3675M, 2020 0.4996M, 2021 0.9362M, 2022 1.3139M, 2023 1.8086M, 2024 1.7892M, 2025 1.6361M (BEV, down amid rising competition). BYD battery-electric-only sales (BYD/CnEVPost/InsideEVs/Statista reporting): 2023 ~1.6M, 2024 1.778M, 2025 2.2567M (surpassing Tesla for the first time, per CNBC/InsideEVs Jan 2026 reporting); 2019-2022 figures approximate, back-modeled from BYD's reported NEV sales mix before its BEV line scaled (2019 ~0.11M, 2020 ~0.11M, 2021 ~0.32M, 2022 ~0.91M). BYD figures exclude its separate plug-in-hybrid line.
